subject: VPC tiered platform fee & optional security add-on — packaging questions
messages:
From: Anna Sullivan <anna.sullivan@medisphere.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@medisphere.com>
Date: 2026-04-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: VPC pricing — tiering questions and security add-on

Hi Nikhil,

Thanks for the demo yesterday. We liked the performance profile and the deployment flexibility, but before we loop in legal/procurement we need a clearer picture on a couple of commercial items:

- Can you break down the platform fee by tier (starter / standard / enterprise) and what exactly is included in the platform fee vs the support retainer?
- Do you offer a stand-alone security add-on (e.g., managed key integration + quarterly pen test evidence) and how is that priced — flat fee or per-seat?
- Medisphere is targetting a 12–18 month pilot; any flexibility on platform fee the first 12 months if we commit to a minimum throughput or a reserved capacity floor?

We’ve attached a one-page of our compliance questions and SOC expectations — if you can flag what you can provide as standard vs add-on that would help speed review.

Looking to get a commercial sketch by Friday so procurement can scope the PO.

Cheers,
Anna
Anna Sullivan
Head of IT Procurement | Medisphere
attachments: Medisphere_SOC_Expectations.pdf

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Anna Sullivan <anna.sullivan@medisphere.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2026-04-29T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: VPC pricing — tiering questions and security add-on

Hi Anna — great to hear and thanks for the clear list. I pulled together the high-level answers below; attaching a PDF with the tier matrix.

High level:
- Platform fee: covers the control plane, model catalog access, observability (console retention 30d), and standard incident response. Tier differences are mostly capacity (reserved GPU pools), retention windows, and SSO/multi-tenant mapping.
- Support retainer: separate line item. Starter includes business-hours email support only; Standard adds 24/7 incident escalation and 4 on-call SRE hours/month; Enterprise includes a named SRE, 24/7 phone escalation, and faster SLA targets.
- Security add-on: offered as an optional bundle. Includes KMS integration, quarterly signed SOC2 evidence pack, and a security review for your onboarding. We price it as a flat annual add-on plus a small per-seat activation for operator licenses (if you want Redwood to manage keys).

Pilot concession idea: for a 12-month pilot with a committed baseline (>= X tokens/month or a reserved 1 GPU pool) we can reduce the platform fee by 25% in month 1–6 and transition to a tiered discount afterwards. This is a one-time pilot concession and tied to minimum commit.

If you’re ok with this direction we’ll: (1) propose a line-item commercial sketch for procurement, (2) loop in Marissa to scope the SOW/credits and (3) have Kimberly confirm the SOC deliverables and evidence cadence.

Best,
Nikhil
Nikhil Sharma
Sr. Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
attachments: Redwood_VPC_Tiers_v3.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Anna Sullivan <anna.sullivan@medisphere.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>, Kim Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-29T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: VPC pricing — tiering questions and security add-on

Hi Anna — adding the commercial detail that aligns with what Nikhil outlined and a concrete concession so procurement can scope the PO: 

Commercial sketch (draft):
- Starter Platform Fee: $15k/mo — includes single-region reserved capacity (small), 30d console retention, email support.
- Standard Platform Fee: $40k/mo — includes up to 2x reserved capacity pools, 90d retention, standard SRE on-call (4 hrs/mo).
- Enterprise Platform Fee: $120k/mo — multi-region pools, 365d retention, named SRE, 24/7 phone escalation.

Support retainer (optional):
- Bronze: $5k/mo (business-hours)
- Silver: $18k/mo (24/7 escalation + 4hrs SRE/mo)
- Gold: $45k/mo (named SRE, guaranteed RTO/RPO tiers)

Security add-on (optional):
- Core Security Bundle: $25k/yr (KMS integrations, quarterly SOC summary, baseline penetration test report).
- Managed KMS: $3k onboarding + $2/user/month (for operator seats).

Pilot concession (proposal for Medisphere):
- 12-month pilot commit: 20% off platform fee months 1–6; 10% off months 7–12.
- Implementation credit: $40k engineering credit applied to onboarding milestones (SOW-based).
- Security add-on: waive first-quarter managed KMS onboarding fee if bundled within pilot.

We can tighten numbers if you provide an expected throughput baseline and number of operator seats. If procurement agrees, I’ll convert this into an SOW+term sheet.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
attachments: Draft_MA_Terms.docx

Let’s schedule a 30-minute call Tuesday 10am PT to finalize the sketch and get procurement aligned.

Anna
